LanguageData.RC_Text_b4336039b1465bc8: Install the reality anchor and suppress the hub
LanguageData.RC_Text_4a756af4b05cd08f: Complete the group recall from current positions
LanguageData.RC_Text_9b1c71a39f7fd13d: Start automatic installation. You can move and fight while it completes in about 60 seconds.
LanguageData.RC_Text_ae708a525a61f888: The reality anchor is installed and the node suppressed. Mason and the surviving reinforcements have warped back aboard the Aurora.
LanguageData.RC_Text_4a0559d1a0ef3150: En taro Artanis. Caesar, the honor is mine.
LanguageData.RC_Text_b944d44d8fc1e30e: I am here to lend you my strength, Mason.
LanguageData.RC_Text_400dff341182a539: Our enemies will fall beneath my blades.
LanguageData.RC_Text_6c04f199300b446b: Aurora, this is Mason. I have reached the target location.
LanguageData.RC_Text_cb9e2a0723d43aa4: A frontal assault would be unwise.
LanguageData.RC_Text_4cb527c34dc69522: Mason, our warriors thirst for enemy blood. Take out that outpost and we can send reinforcements to aid you.
LanguageData.RC_Text_fc78fd54bb15d80a: Another outpost, Mason. Destroy it and we will send warriors to assist you.
LanguageData.RC_Text_84fc130154f129f3: That is the last outpost, Mason.
LanguageData.RC_Text_d57e7b63f27836c4: The enemy is upon us. Templar, prepare for battle.
LanguageData.RC_Text_b4460fe1efd8f256: Reinforcements spotted. They are moving toward the core.
LanguageData.RC_Text_2b5c19fcb650c5a4: Installation complete. Hurry, warp back aboard!
LanguageData.RC_Text_dbedc43a8d3785cc: We have a lock on your positions. Executing group recall.
LanguageData.RC_Text_f9d47c282cc97dd3: Destroy outpost 1's obelisk and clear its defenders (optional)
LanguageData.RC_Text_0545d7592382ec11: Destroy outpost 2's obelisk and clear its defenders (optional)
LanguageData.RC_Text_7ca6645f4a2b2c7d: Destroy outpost 3's obelisk and clear its defenders (optional)
